picks.name: chaojifeng-video-content-creator
picks.what: An open-source video creation skill packed with 148 ready-to-use HTML and GSAP animation effects, storyboarding, and subtitle routines.
picks.why: Our studio's render engine (HyperFrames) is purely HTML + GSAP in headless Chrome. Stealing its 148 HTML/GSAP animation components directly supercharges compose_lab.py with fresh kinetic typography, HUD overlays, and transition effects without new dependencies.
picks.free: MIT licence, 100% open-source code on GitHub.
picks.how: Inspect the repository's HTML/GSAP effects directory and adapt the top 10 kinetic text and layout transitions into compose_lab.py templates.
picks.risk: Some scripts and comments are in Chinese, needing quick LLM translation during extraction.
picks.title: mileson/chaojifeng-video-content-creator

picks.name: ViralForge
picks.what: An agent-native CLI and MCP toolkit that deconstructs viral short video hooks and scripts into structural DNA reports and generates hook variants.
picks.why: Enhances research.py and plan.py to systematically extract high-retention hook patterns and generate A/B hook variations for Kaise Tech and Puraan Ki Katha.
picks.free: Apache-2.0 licence, open source, bring your own API key (works with Gemini free tier).
picks.how: Port the Viral DNA hook deconstruction prompt and variant generation schema into research.py and plan.py.
picks.risk: Avoid over-complicating prompt token usage on Gemini free rate limits.
picks.title: fendouai/ViralForge

picks.name: motlab
picks.what: A video-as-code toolkit rendering canvas scenes with WebCodecs in headless Chrome, accompanied by an interactive review viewer.
picks.why: Provides reference architecture for accelerated rendering via WebCodecs and a visual review viewer that can streamline preflight.py and review.py inspections.
picks.how: Study their headless Chrome WebCodecs pipeline to benchmark against current Puppeteer/FFmpeg render times on a 2-core ARM server.
picks.risk: WebCodecs hardware acceleration might be limited on a headless ARM server without GPU.
picks.title: staryone/motlab

picks.name: youtube-seo-optimizer
picks.what: A local CLI tool to audit and optimize video titles, descriptions, keyword density, and hashtags for YouTube rankings.
picks.why: Directly tackles items on our 'Not built yet' list (hashtag research and metadata preparation for YouTube Shorts expansion).
picks.free: MIT licence, completely local and open source with zero API costs.
picks.how: Integrate its metadata auditing rules into publish.py to automatically format tags and SEO-optimized descriptions before posting.
picks.risk: Algorithmic recommendations must be adapted for vertical Shorts rather than long-form search intent.
picks.title: BankerInterface/youtube-seo-optimizer

picks.name: mdldm-maitian
picks.what: An automated multi-platform publishing hub and metrics monitor supporting YouTube, X, and other video networks.
picks.why: Our studio has not yet wired up the YouTube uploader in publish.py; this repo provides practical, working token management and API upload code for YouTube.
picks.how: Review the YouTube publishing adapter code and port the OAuth/upload routine into publish.py.
picks.risk: Includes many domestic Chinese platforms that are irrelevant to our workflow; extract only the YouTube module.
picks.title: CzzzzzzJ/mdldm-maitian
